status: NOT_STARTED — this stage ships no rollout
why_a_config_change_is_not_enough: the compiled ceilings in flags.py are all zero and clamp any configuration or environment value to zero, so enabling comments requires a source change, a review and an audit record

stages.name: local review
stages.requires: owner reads the evidence and the code

stages.name: staging, one site, read only
requires: migration applied to a staging database with a rehearsed rollback
COMMENTS_READ_ENABLED ceiling raised to 1 in source
stages.exit: no cross-tenant attempt served; API error rate within budget

stages.name: staging, one site, writes with pre-moderation
stages.exit: moderation outcomes reviewed; no spam published

stages.name: production canary, one site, 1%
requires: four-eyes approval: the author of the change does not approve it
stages.exit: observation window completed with a recorded keep verdict

stages.name: widen within one site, then to further sites
stages.rule: never beyond canary without a completed observation and a keep verdict; one site at a time

blocking_conditions: pending or hidden content found in public output
a moderation action without a reason
an audit gap for any privileged operation
a failing test in any required category
